Introduction

Apeace Lapis5, formerly known as Apeace Lapis, was one of three sub-units of the boy group Apeace. The unit began promotions in September 2012 with seven members: Hyunsung, Byunghun, Changwoo, Wanchul, Seunghyun, Jinwoo, and Jinhong. After the departure of Seunghyun in 2014, member Junsik was added to the group.

After Apeace went through several lineup changes, eventually reaching a total of 15 members, the units were reorganized into groups of five. With Lapis becoming Lapis5, the new lineup consisted of Wanchul, Jinhong, Sehyun, Youngwook, and Sihyuk. The group later stopped promoting in sub-units around 2015, following the departures and hiatuses of several members.
